statement: A CVE tied to the Microsoft Defender ShieldBreak privilege-escalation flaw disclosed around 11 Aug 2026 will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a CVE matching the ShieldBreak Defender flaw with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No CVE matching the ShieldBreak Defender flaw appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded in the stated window as of the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A Houthi or other Iran-aligned attack will kill at least one person in Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, or Strait of Hormuz shipping-lane activity between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, beyond the fatalities already reported 12 Aug 2026.
resolution: TRUE if two or more wire services report a fatal Houthi or Iran-aligned attack on shipping or shipping-adjacent targets in the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, or Strait of Hormuz corridor between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04.
failure_condition: No two-source wire report of a fatal Houthi or Iran-aligned attack on shipping-lane targets in that corridor is dated within the stated window.
